difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the existence of a nonzero element of the maximal ideal of the base whose localizations at suitably chosen points of the components of the special fibre factor with a factor cutting out the corresponding component (statement lines 1622-1632). The proof (proof lines 1633-1641) chooses points and local elements and multiplies the numerators of their expressions as fractions of elements of the base. H2: a complete short construction.
